item.title: Charging Is Automatic. Refunding Isn't.
item.description: Photo source: Interactive Powers Charging Is Automatic. Refunding Isn’t. When automation only works in one direction, the customer notices. A subscription renews itself for two years. No human involvement, done in a second. The customer didn’t want it renewed and asks for it to be reversed. What happens next isn’t unique to any one company. That’s why it’s worth looking at. Automatic to charge, manual to undo The charge was instant.
